deletePage.title: Delete your Chardeevari account
deletePage.intro: You can permanently delete your Chardeevari account and personal data from the Chardeevari app or right here on the website.

steps.app: In the Chardeevari app: open Account → Delete account, type DELETE and confirm.
steps.web: On this website: log in below with your registered phone number, then tap "Delete my account", type DELETE and confirm.
steps.email: Or email chardeevari.construction@gmail.com from your registered email, or with your registered phone number, asking us to delete your account.

items.personal: Deleted immediately: your name, phone number, email and Google sign-in link.
items.saved: Deleted immediately: your saved addresses, cart, reviews and login codes. Your device's notification token is unlinked from your account.
items.invoices: Kept: order records and invoices (items, amounts, and the delivery address and phone used for each order) are retained for 72 months from the due date of the annual GST return for that financial year, as required by Indian GST law. They are no longer linked to any account.
items.activeOrders: If an order is still being delivered, please wait for it to be delivered or cancel it first.

deletePage.notCustomer: Merchant and admin accounts can't be deleted here. Please contact support at {{phone}}.
deletePage.loginPrompt: Log in with your registered phone number to continue.

deletePanel.title: Delete account
deletePanel.subtitle: Permanently delete your Chardeevari account and personal data.
deletePanel.warning: This cannot be undone. You will be logged out.

items.personal: Your name, phone number, email and Google sign-in link are erased
items.saved: Saved addresses, cart and reviews are deleted
items.invoices: Past order invoices are kept as required by GST law, but are no longer linked to an account

deletePanel.success: Your account and personal data have been deleted.
